label: PF Backlog 199
title: Backend: media agents (media-analyst / media-generator / media-editor / asset-librarian)
body:
## Problem / why
No agent understands, generates, edits, or organises media.

## Goal
Add pluggable media agents, enabled only when the capability pack is active:
- media-analyst: VLM understanding of image/audio/video.
- media-generator: drive generator models.
- media-editor: cut/merge/render (ffmpeg/MoviePy/Blender).
- asset-librarian: index/manage the asset store.

## Acceptance criteria
- Agents are added to the roster + stages and gated by the capability pack.
- Each agent declares knowledge/skills (agent-knowledge audit stays green).

## Verification / test plan
- Enable the media pack -> agents appear and run in the media stages; disabled otherwise.


## Roster (8 agents) - role, model(s), tools, stage placement
- **capability-strategist** -> new stage `0f` (post-ideation): detect modalities, enable packs, pick
  kinds + free/paid mix (uses the existing text tier). Tools: core/modality.py, catalog, capability-packs.
- **media-analyst** -> `0a`/`1d`/`1` (+`4m`): VLM (Qwen2.5-VL / InternVL / SmolVLM), Whisper (ASR),
  CLAP (audio tags). Consumers of media ingest (BI-0187).
- **media-generator** -> new stage `4m`: FLUX.1-schnell/Sana (image), Wan 2.2/Mochi/CogVideoX (video),
  ACE-Step (music), TripoSR/TRELLIS (3D), Kokoro/Piper (TTS), Whisper (STT) via adapters (BI-0188/0193).
- **media-editor** -> `4m`, `9`: FFmpeg / MoviePy / Blender (external).
- **asset-librarian** -> cross-stage: BGE/CLIP embeddings; asset store (BI-0187), phash dedupe, provenance/licence.
- **doc-analyst** -> `0a`/`1`, `4m`: Tesseract/PaddleOCR/RapidOCR/docTR (+ Qwen-VL for hard pages) (BI-0209).
- **sensor-analyst** -> `1b`/`2`, `4m`: IsolationForest/autoencoder (anomaly), DLinear/PatchTST/Chronos
  (forecast); ingest adapters (BI-0208).
- **media-qa** -> `5`/`6`: ffprobe / loudness / phash / A-V sync / caption validators (BI-0191).

Existing agents that GAIN media duties: architect (media services in stack), document (captions),
a11y-audit (alt-text/captions), security (media threats), package (bundle-licence check), finops &
pricing-strategist (per-unit media cost).

Stage-composition mechanics (how `0f`/`4m`/media-QA are injected per pack) -> BI-0213.
Full reference: docs/tools-and-generators.md (SS9-12).
